office_does: The county clerk keeps the records and handles the money of the Lincoln County Superior Court.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Clerk Traci Gants, elected in 2022 after 16 years as a deputy clerk, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Lincoln County Clerk since 2023, in the clerk's office for about 20 years; seeking a second term.
highlights: About 20 years in the clerk's office, first as deputy clerk [S1][S3]
Unopposed in 2022 and in the 2026 primary [S4][S5]
